author: IGN YouTube
text:
The Elder Scrolls 6 Reveal Could Be As Early As Next Month - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Some leaked info surrounding The Elder Scrolls 6 has popped up again, and The Verge is reporting that an official reveal could be around the corner, possibly November. A leaked, but unverified, title was floating around not too long ago, suggesting the official name for the game is The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel, and The Verge is sticking by that name. The setting for the game is also heavily rumored to be Hammerfell. In other news, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma insists that Series X and S sales are being constrained by their availability...yeah sure. A quick glance at any major retailer's website shows the Xbox Series X and S and their many variants are in stock (except of course for some of the limited edition models). And finally, Phantom Blade Zero is a hit for Chinese game studio S-GAME. The game debuted to the number two spot on Steam's most-played list, with around 723,000 concurrents.

text:
Pendulum - Official Trailer #2 (2026) Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Phoebe Dynevor, Norman Reedus
Watch the trailer for Pendulum, an upcoming thriller mystery movie starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Phoebe Dynevor, Anna Deavere Smith, Jena Malone, with Norman Reedus, and Jacki Weaver. 

After a shared tragedy, Patrick (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) and Abigail (Phoebe Dynevor) seek healing at a secluded new-age retreat in New Mexico. But as Abigail falls deeper under the spell of the group’s charismatic leader (Jacki Weaver), Patrick's fear for his wife spirals into something far more sinister. Is he losing her to a cult, or losing his grip on reality? Trapped between his own unraveling mind and a truth he can't yet see, Patrick must untangle the truth before it costs him everything.

Pendulum is produced by  Darren Aronofsky, Jacob Jaffke p.g.a., Élan Klein Jaffke p.g.a., Will Greenfield p.g.a., Mark Heyman, and Dave Caplan. It is written by Mark Heyman.

Pendulum, directed by Mark Heyman, opens in theaters nationwide on January 1, 2027.

Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Review Crew: A Great Campaign, But There's a Catch
Welcome to IGN's Review Crew, where IGN's reviewers and other reviewers break down their verdicts on the biggest releases in gaming. Today, the panel dives deep into the Crew's Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Review, the highly anticipated final installment of Infinity Ward's rebooted CoD quadrilogy.

Join host Daemon Hatfield, IGN's Simon Cardy (Modern Warfare 4 Campaign & Multiplayer reviewer) and Jarrett Green (MW4 DMZ reviewer), alongside special guest Riana Manuel-Pena from GamerTag Radio, as they unpack the entirety of the MW4. With the game currently sitting at an impressive 86 on OpenCritic, the consensus is overwhelmingly positive. But is Modern Warfare 4 worth playing? Or there any part of the new Call of Duty that misses the mark?
